$comment: Registry of privacy canaries (docs/data-inventory.md §8, E14-01 case 2, REQ-005). canary-page.html places every value where a careless sensor would pick it up; scripts/privacy-scan.mjs asserts none of them appears in storage.session, storage.local or the export preview. Values are unique literals, not secrets. Keep this file and canary-page.html in sync: the scan verifies the page reported each value as used.

canaries.where: location.search of the fixture URL (also pushState)
DOM text, localStorage value, string passed to new URL()
function name on the call stack of getImageData
